name: GTA V depth buffer self-driving ML experiment

mentions.name: GTA V depth buffer self-driving ML experiment
mentions.description: This project hacks GTA V's graphics pipeline to gain access to the game's depth buffer, which is then fed into a self-driving machine learning model. It is framed as a learning exercise in intercepting game processes and extracting data, going beyond existing tools like ReShade and DX11 hooks, with the goal of generalizing the technique to other types of data and processes.
